part_description: Mild steel stepped shaft, 60mm max diameter, 180mm length, one M8 blind threaded hole, one rectangular keyway 16x6mm, h6 tolerance on main journals, Ra 1.6 surface finish
retrieved_rules_used: TOOL_RULE [turning_mild_steel]: roughing tool: Carbide insert CNMG 432 grade P25 — cutting speed 80-120 m/min; finishing tool: Carbide insert DCMT 070204 grade P10 — cutting speed 150-200 m/min. Source: Machining Data Handbook, Ch.3 — Turning
CUTTING_PARAMS [mild_steel + drilling]: For drilling of mild_steel — cutting speed: 20-30 m/min, feed: 0.1-0.25 mm/rev, depth of cut: full_depth mm. Source: Machining Data Handbook, Table 4.1
CUTTING_PARAMS [mild_steel + rough_turning]: For rough_turning of mild_steel — cutting speed: 80-120 m/min, feed: 0.25-0.4 mm/rev, depth of cut: 2-5 mm. Source: Machining Data Handbook, Table 3.1

TOLERANCE_RULE [h6]: For h6 tolerance, mandatory finishing operation is cylindrical_grinding. Typical Ra: 0.4-0.8 microns. Note: Grinding mandatory — turning alone cannot achieve IT6. Source: ISO 286-1:2010 — Geometrical product specifications

TOLERANCE_RULE [H8]: For H8 tolerance, mandatory finishing operation is semi_finish_turning or reaming. Typical Ra: 1.6-3.2 microns. Note: Fine turning acceptable — general sliding fit. Source: ISO 286-1:2010 — Geometrical product specifications

TOLERANCE_RULE [H7]: For H7 tolerance, mandatory finishing operation is reaming or fine_boring. Typical Ra: 0.8-1.6 microns. Note: Reaming after drilling, or fine boring — standard bearing fit. Source: ISO 286-1:2010 — Geometrical product specifications
SEQUENCING_RULE [priority 12]: Chamfering and deburring are always the final operations. Source: Machining Data Handbook, Ch.1
SEQUENCING_RULE [priority 3]: All semi-finish operations before finish operations. Source: Machining Data Handbook, Ch.1
SEQUENCING_RULE [priority 7]: Internal features (bores, holes, pockets) before external finishing operations. Source: Machining Data Handbook, Ch.1

FEATURE_RULE [round_external_cylinder]: To machine round_external_cylinder, perform these operations in order: rough_turning, semi_finish_turning, finish_turning. . Source: Machining Data Handbook, Metcut Research, Ch.3
planning_notes: This process plan follows all sequencing rules and achieves the required surface finish and tolerance.
